title: Pixtral Vision & Mistral Embeddings
summary: Process complex document images, charts, and technical diagrams with Pixtral and index documents with Mistral Embeddings.
objectives: Pass image URLs and Base64 payloads to Pixtral 12B / Pixtral Large vision models.
Extract structured key-value data from complex scanned invoices and engineering diagrams.
Generate high-dimensional embeddings using `mistral-embed` for semantic search indexing.

sections.title: Multimodal Vision with Pixtral
paragraphs: Pixtral is natively trained on arbitrary image resolutions and aspect ratios, avoiding distortion when analyzing widescreen architectural blueprints or tall financial receipts.

questions.prompt: What advantage does Pixtral offer for processing technical diagrams and invoices?
choices: It natively supports arbitrary image aspect ratios and resolutions without square image distortion.
It only works with black-and-white 1-bit bitmap images.
It requires all images to be printed on paper first.
It replaces the GPU with an optical laser.
questions.explanation: Pixtral supports flexible native aspect ratios and resolutions, preserving exact line clarity in technical diagrams and complex tables.
